messages.content: What was Luis Castillo's ERA in April 2025?

SELECT   (SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0) / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0) AS era FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Luis Castillo' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND DATE(pgl.game_date) BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
Can you also add in the number of strikeouts he had for April 2025?

SELECT   (SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0) / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0) AS era,   SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Luis Castillo' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND DATE(pgl.game_date) BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
How many home runs has Julio Rodriguez hit this season in 2025?

SELECT   SUM(hs.home_runs) AS total_home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Julio Rodriguez' WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season = 2025
how many home runs has Julio Rodriguez hit in 2025 so far?

SELECT hs.home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl    ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Julio Rodriguez') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season    = 2025
in a new table, how many innings has Logan Gilbert thrown this year?

SELECT gs.innings_pitched FROM pitcher_season_statistics AS gs JOIN players AS pl    ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Logan Gilbert') WHERE gs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND gs.season = 2025
The innings pitched frame is empty, try running the query again to make sure it works.

SELECT gs.innings_pitched FROM pitcher_season_statistics AS gs JOIN players AS pl    ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Logan Gilbert') WHERE gs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND gs.season = 2025   AND gs.innings_pitched IS NOT NULL;
what are the top five venues in terms of average home team runs in 2025?
SELECT   g.venue,   AVG(g.home_score) AS avg_home_runs FROM mlb_game_data_2025 AS g WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM g.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY g.venue ORDER BY avg_home_runs DESC LIMIT 5
what are the top 5 wrc+ for the season? Include the player's name in the table.

SELECT hs.name, hs.wrc_plus FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025 AND hs.plate_appearances >= (SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1 FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2 WHERE hs2.season = 2025) ORDER BY hs.wrc_plus DESC LIMIT 5
what has been Jorge Polanco's OPS in May of 2025?

WITH daily AS (SELECT pd.game_date::DATE AS game_date, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.events IN ('single','double','triple','home_run') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hits, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.events IN ('walk','hit_by_pitch') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_base, SUM(CASE pd.events WHEN 'single' THEN 1 WHEN 'double' THEN 2 WHEN 'triple' THEN 3 WHEN 'home_run' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS total_bases, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.events NOT IN ('walk','hit_by_pitch','sacrifice','catcher_interference','intent_walk') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_bats FROM pitch_data pd JOIN players pl ON pl.key_mlbam::TEXT = pd.batter_id AND CONCAT(pl."First_Name",' ',pl."Last_Name")='Jorge Polanco' WHERE pd.game_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY pd.game_date::DATE), monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',game_date)::DATE AS month, SUM(hits) AS hits, SUM(on_base) AS on_base, SUM(total_bases) AS total_bases, SUM(at_bats) AS at_bats FROM daily GROUP BY 1), metrics AS (SELECT month, hits::FLOAT/NULLIF(at_bats,0) AS BA, (hits+on_base)::FLOAT/NULLIF(at_bats+on_base,0) AS OBP, total_bases::FLOAT/NULLIF(at_bats,0) AS SLG, ((hits+on_base)::FLOAT/NULLIF(at_bats+on_base,0))+(total_bases::FLOAT/NULLIF(at_bats,0)) AS OPS FROM monthly), rolling AS (SELECT month, OPS, AVG(OPS) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_ops FROM metrics) SELECT month, OPS, rolling_ops FROM rolling ORDER BY month;
what has Jorge Polanco batting average been in may?

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN pd.events IN ('single','double','triple','home_run') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pd.events NOT IN ('walk','hit_by_pitch','sacrifice','catcher_interference','intent_walk') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS batting_average FROM pitch_data AS pd JOIN players AS pl ON pl.key_mlbam::TEXT = pd.batter_id AND CONCAT(pl."First_Name",' ',pl."Last_Name") = 'Jorge Polanco' WHERE pd.game_date::DATE BETWEEN '2025-05-01' AND '2025-05-31'
who is leading the league in home runs this year?

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = '2023'  -- Specify the season here   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = '2023'  -- Specify the season here   ) ORDER BY hs.home_runs DESC LIMIT 1
this is the wrong answer, how many home runs does shohei ohtani have this year?

SELECT hs.home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl    ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Shohei Ohtani') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season    = 2025
how many strikeouts does tarik skubal have this year?

SELECT SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Tarik Skubal' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2023
how many strikeouts does tarik skubal have in 2025?

SELECT      EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) AS year,     SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Tarik Skubal' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) IN (2023, 2025) GROUP BY year
who are the top five pitchers in strikeouts in 2025?

SELECT    pl.key_mlbam,   pl.player_name,   SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl ON pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY pl.key_mlbam, pl.player_name ORDER BY total_strikeouts DESC LIMIT 5
can you add their ERA onto this table too for 2025?

SELECT ps.key_mlbam, ps.name, ps.team, (SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0) / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0) AS era FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN pitcher_season_statistics AS ps ON pgl.pitcher_id = ps.key_mlbam::FLOAT::INT JOIN teams AS t ON ps.team = t.abbreviation_games WHERE ps.season = 2025 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY ps.key_mlbam, ps.name, ps.team, t.games_played HAVING (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0) >= (t.games_played * 0.75) ORDER BY era ASC LIMIT 5;
what is Cal Raleigh's slugging and on base percentage for 2025?

SELECT   hs.slugging_percentage,   hs.on_base_percentage FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl   ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name")) = unaccent('Cal Raleigh') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season = 2025
adding those two columns together, what is his OPS?

SELECT hs.on_base_percentage, hs.slugging_percentage, COALESCE(hs.on_base_percentage, 0) + COALESCE(hs.slugging_percentage, 0) AS ops FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name")) = unaccent('Cal Raleigh') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam AND hs.season = 2025;
adding Cal Raleigh's on base percentage and slugging together, what is his OPS for 2025?

SELECT   hs.on_base_percentage + hs.slugging_percentage AS ops FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl   ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name")) = unaccent('Cal Raleigh') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season = 2025
okay can you do this for the top 10 hitters in batting averages in 2025? So add in the on base percentage + slugging percentage to get the OPS.

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.batting_average,   hs.on_base_percentage,   hs.slugging_percentage,   (hs.on_base_percentage + hs.slugging_percentage) AS ops FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = 2025   ) ORDER BY hs.batting_average DESC LIMIT 10
for this exact table above, add in the home runs each player has hit so far in 2025.

SELECT pl."First_Name", pl."Last_Name", hs.batting_average, hs.on_base_percentage, hs.slugging_percentage, COALESCE(hs.on_base_percentage, 0) + COALESCE(hs.slugging_percentage, 0) AS ops, hs.home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl ON hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam JOIN teams AS t ON hs.team = t.abbreviation_games WHERE hs.season = 2025 AND hs.plate_appearances >= t.games_played * 3.1 ORDER BY hs.batting_average DESC LIMIT 10;
what was the score of the Mariners game on May 28th 2025?
SELECT game_id, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score FROM mlb_game_data_2025 WHERE game_date::DATE = '2025-05-28' AND ('Seattle Mariners' IN (home_team, away_team));
show me tarik skubal month by month era so far in 2025?

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   (SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0) / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0) AS era FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Tarik Skubal' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
now show me how many home runs and rbis aaron judge has in 2025

SELECT   hs.home_runs,   hs.rbi FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl   ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Aaron Judge') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season = 2025
who are the top 5 players in average exit velocity in 2025?

SELECT   m.name,   AVG(m.avg_exit_velocity) AS avg_exit_velocity FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY avg_exit_velocity DESC LIMIT 5
who are the top five players in average exit velocity with at least 150 plate appearances?

SELECT pl."First_Name", pl."Last_Name", AVG(pd.launch_speed) AS avg_exit_velocity FROM pitch_data AS pd JOIN players AS pl ON pd.batter_id = pl.key_mlbam JOIN hitter_season_statistics AS hs ON hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam AND hs."season" = 2025 JOIN teams AS t ON pl."teamID" = t.abbreviation_games AND hs."season" = 2025 WHERE pd.description IN ('hit_into_play', 'hit_into_play_score', 'hit_into_play_no_out') AND pd.launch_speed IS NOT NULL AND pd.launch_speed::TEXT NOT ILIKE '%nan%' AND pd.launch_speed::TEXT NOT ILIKE '%inf%' AND hs.plate_appearances >= t.games_played * 3.1 GROUP BY pl.key_mlbam, pl."First_Name", pl."Last_Name" ORDER BY avg_exit_velocity DESC LIMIT 5;
who are the top five players in average exit velocity with at least 150 plate appearances?

SELECT pl."First_Name", pl."Last_Name", AVG(pd.launch_speed) AS avg_exit_velocity FROM pitch_data AS pd JOIN players AS pl ON pd.batter_id = pl.key_mlbam JOIN hitter_season_statistics AS hs ON hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam AND hs."season" = 2025 JOIN teams AS t ON pl."teamID" = t.abbreviation_games AND hs."season" = 2025 WHERE pd.description IN ('hit_into_play', 'hit_into_play_score', 'hit_into_play_no_out') AND pd.launch_speed IS NOT NULL AND pd.launch_speed::TEXT NOT ILIKE '%nan%' AND pd.launch_speed::TEXT NOT ILIKE '%inf%' AND hs.plate_appearances >= t.games_played * 3.1 GROUP BY pl.key_mlbam, pl."First_Name", pl."Last_Name" ORDER BY avg_exit_velocity DESC LIMIT 5;
Who are the top five pitchers in strikeouts in 2025?

SELECT   pl.key_mlbam,   pl.player_name,   SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl   ON pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY pl.key_mlbam, pl.player_name ORDER BY total_strikeouts DESC LIMIT 5
how many runs have the Mariners averaged as the away team the last 7 days, so from May 21-May 29?
SELECT AVG(away_score) AS avg_away_runs FROM mlb_game_data_2025 WHERE away_team = 'Seattle Mariners' AND game_date BETWEEN '2025-05-21' AND '2025-05-29' AND away_score IS NOT NULL;
how many runs have the Seattle Mariners averaged as the away team the last 7 days, so from May 21-May 29?
SELECT AVG(away_score) AS avg_away_runs FROM mlb_game_data_2025 WHERE away_team = 'Seattle Mariners' AND game_date BETWEEN '2025-05-21' AND '2025-05-29' AND away_score IS NOT NULL;
How many runs have the Seattle Mariners scored in each month so far in 2025?

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', g.game_date) AS month,   SUM(m.runs) AS total_runs FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m JOIN mlb_game_data_2025 AS g   ON m.game_id = g.game_id WHERE g.home_team = 'Seattle Mariners' OR g.away_team = 'Seattle Mariners'   AND EXTRACT(year FROM g.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
how many strikeouts do they have each month in 2025?

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   SUM(pgl.strikeouts)                                    AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name")) = unaccent('<Player Name>') WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
how many strikeouts do the mariners have as a team each month in 2025?

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', game_date) AS month, SUM(batting_runs) AS total_runs_scored, SUM(batting_strikeOuts) AS batter_strikeouts, SUM(pitching_strikeOuts) AS team_pitching_strikeouts FROM team_game_stats WHERE team_name = 'Seattle Mariners' AND game_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', game_date) ORDER BY month;
How many strikeouts does logan gilbert have per month in 2025?

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   SUM(pgl.strikeouts)                                    AS strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Logan Gilbert' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
can you add his ERA per month onto this table as well for 2025?

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date) AS month, SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts, ROUND((SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0) / NULLIF(SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0, 0), 2) AS era FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl ON pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT WHERE pl."First_Name" = 'Logan' AND pl."Last_Name" = 'Gilbert' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date) ORDER BY month;
Which teams have the most strikeouts as an offense so far in 2025?
SELECT team_name, SUM(batting_strikeOuts) AS total_strikeouts FROM team_game_stats WHERE game_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY total_strikeouts DESC;
can you add onto this table the team's average batting average for 2025?
SELECT   m.team,   SUM(m.strikeOuts) AS total_strikeouts FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY m.team ORDER BY total_strikeouts DESC;
can you add here the team batting average on this table for each team in 2025?
SELECT   m.team,   SUM(m.strikeOuts) AS total_strikeouts FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY m.team ORDER BY total_strikeouts DESC;
which team has the highest team batting average in 2025?

SELECT team_name, ROUND(SUM(batting_hits)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(batting_atBats), 0), 3) AS batting_avg FROM team_game_stats WHERE game_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY team_name ORDER BY batting_avg DESC LIMIT 1;
who are the top five players in home runs for 2025?

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = 2025   ) ORDER BY hs.home_runs DESC LIMIT 5
can you add onto this table each player's corresponding batting average?

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.home_runs,   hs.hits * 1.0 / hs.plate_appearances AS batting_average FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = 2025   ) ORDER BY hs.home_runs DESC LIMIT 5
what is Corbin Carroll's WRC+ so far in 2025?

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.home_runs,   hs.hits * 1.0 / hs.plate_appearances AS batting_average,   hs.wrc_plus FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.name = 'Corbin Carroll' ORDER BY hs.home_runs DESC LIMIT 1
can you tell me the score of the Seattle Mariners game on May 28th, 2025?

SELECT game_id, game_date, home_team, home_score, away_team, away_score FROM mlb_game_data_2025 WHERE game_date::DATE = '2025-05-28' AND ('Seattle Mariners' = home_team OR 'Seattle Mariners' = away_team);
how many strikeouts does Bryce Miller have this year by month in 2025?

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   SUM(pgl.strikeouts)                                    AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name")) = unaccent('Bryce Miller') WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Show Bryan Woo’s monthly K/9 for the 2025 season.

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date) AS month, ROUND((SUM(pgl.strikeouts) * 9.0) / NULLIF(SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0, 0), 2) AS k_per_9 FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl ON pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT WHERE pl."First_Name" = 'Bryan' AND pl."Last_Name" = 'Woo' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date) ORDER BY month;
List Corbin Burnes’s BB/9 by month in 2025.

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   (SUM(pgl.walks) * 9.0)     / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0)                AS bb_per_9 FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Corbin Burnes' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
What is Emerson Hancock’s monthly ERA so far in 2025?

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date) AS month, (SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0) / NULLIF(SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0, 0) AS era FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl ON pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT WHERE pl."First_Name" = 'Emerson' AND pl."Last_Name" = 'Hancock' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date) ORDER BY month;
Show Mackenzie Gore’s total strikeouts in April 2025.

SELECT   SUM(pgl.strikeouts) AS total_strikeouts FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Mackenzie Gore' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025   AND EXTRACT(month FROM pgl.game_date) = 4
List the top 5 qualified hitters by OPS in 2025.

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.ops FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = 2025   ) ORDER BY hs.ops DESC LIMIT 5
Which hitters meet the PA qualification in 2025 and who leads in batting average?

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.ops,   hs.batting_average FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = 2025   ) ORDER BY hs.batting_average DESC LIMIT 5
What are the top 10 wOBA values in merged_pitch_box_scores_2025?
SELECT m.wOBA FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m ORDER BY m.wOBA DESC LIMIT 10
Which player recorded the highest avg_exit_velocity in May 2025?

SELECT   m.name,   m.avg_exit_velocity FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025   AND EXTRACT(month FROM m.game_date) = 5 ORDER BY m.avg_exit_velocity DESC LIMIT 1
For each game in June 2025, show scaled_game_score and series_description.

SELECT m.game_id, m.game_date, m.scaled_game_score, g.series_description FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m JOIN mlb_game_data_2025 AS g ON m.game_id = g.game_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.game_date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.game_date) = 6 ORDER BY m.game_date;
Who won the most away games in April 2025?

SELECT   CASE     WHEN g.home_score < g.away_score THEN g.away_team     ELSE g.home_team   END                            AS winner,   COUNT(*)                       AS wins FROM mlb_game_data_2025 AS g WHERE EXTRACT(year  FROM g.game_date)  = 2025   AND EXTRACT(month FROM g.game_date) = 4 GROUP BY winner ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1
Show each team’s average scaled_game_score in June 2025.

SELECT m.team, ROUND(AVG(m.scaled_game_score), 2) AS avg_scaled_game_score FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.game_date) = 2025 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM m.game_date) = 6 GROUP BY m.team ORDER BY avg_scaled_game_score DESC;
Show Julio Rodríguez’s BABIP by month in 2025.

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', game_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(hits - homeRuns)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(atBats - strikeOuts - homeRuns + sacFlies), 0), 3) AS babip FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 WHERE name = 'Julio Rodríguez' AND game_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', game_date) ORDER BY month;
What was the single longest hit (max_hit_distance) by Mookie Betts in 2025?

SELECT   MAX(m.max_hit_distance) AS longest_hit_distance FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m JOIN players AS pl    ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Mookie Betts' WHERE m.batter_id = pl.key_mlbam   AND EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025
Who leads MLB in stolenBases so far in 2025?

SELECT   hs.key_mlbam,   hs.name,   hs.stolen_bases FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025   AND hs.plate_appearances >= (     SELECT MAX(hs2.games) * 3.1       FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs2      WHERE hs2.season = 2025   ) ORDER BY hs.stolen_bases DESC LIMIT 1
List Juan Soto’s RBI totals by month for the 2025 season.

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', m.game_date)                     AS month,   SUM(m.rbi)                                            AS rbi_totals FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m JOIN players                                          AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Juan Soto' WHERE m.batter_id = pl.key_mlbam   AND EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
How many homeRuns has Fernando Tatis Jr. hit through May 2025?

SELECT hs.home_runs FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl    ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Fernando Tatis Jr.') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season = 2025    AND hs.games > 0;
Which pitcher has thrown the most innings_pitched in May 2025?

SELECT   pl.player_name,   SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0 AS innings_pitched FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players AS pl   ON pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025   AND EXTRACT(month FROM pgl.game_date) = 5 GROUP BY pl.player_name ORDER BY innings_pitched DESC LIMIT 1
Show Sandy Alcantara’s SIERA by month in 2025.

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0 / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0) AS siera FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Sandy Alcantara' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
List all games in 2025 where the home_score exceeded 10
SELECT * FROM mlb_game_data_2025 WHERE home_score > 10   AND EXTRACT(year FROM game_date) = 2025
Which player_id in merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 has at least one game with total_barrels ≥ 2 in May 2025?
SELECT DISTINCT m.player_id FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE m.total_barrels >= 2   AND m.game_date BETWEEN '2025-05-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-05-31T23:59:59Z'
Show Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s slugging percentage (SLG) so far in the 2025 season

SELECT hs.slugging_percentage FROM hitter_season_statistics AS hs JOIN players AS pl    ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name"))       = unaccent('Vladimir Guerrero Jr.') WHERE hs.key_mlbam = pl.key_mlbam   AND hs.season = 2025
List the top 5 starting pitchers by wins in the 2025 season.
SELECT hs.name, hs.team, hs.wins FROM pitcher_season_statistics AS hs WHERE hs.season = 2025 ORDER BY hs.wins DESC LIMIT 5;
What is Clayton Kershaw’s month‑by‑month walk rate (BB%) for the 2025 season?

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   (SUM(pgl.walks) * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0, 0) AS bb_percent FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Clayton Kershaw' WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
Show Aaron Judge’s on‑base percentage by month for the first half of 2025.

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', game_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(hits + baseOnBalls + hitByPitch)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(atBats + baseOnBalls + hitByPitch + sacFlies), 0), 3) AS obp FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 WHERE name = 'Aaron Judge' AND game_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', game_date) ORDER BY month;
Which team had the highest average away_score in April 2025?
SELECT away_team, ROUND(AVG(away_score), 2) AS avg_away_score FROM mlb_game_data_2025 WHERE game_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30' GROUP BY away_team ORDER BY avg_away_score DESC LIMIT 1;
Which batter in merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 has the highest strikeOuts per atBat ratio so far in 2025?

SELECT m.player_id, m.name, (CAST(m.strikeOuts AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(m.atBats, 0)) AS strikeouts_per_atbat FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025 ORDER BY strikeouts_per_atbat DESC LIMIT 1
List the monthly groundball percentage (GB%) for Zack Wheeler in 2025.

SELECT   DATE_TRUNC('month', pgl.game_date)                     AS month,   (SUM(pgl.earned_runs) * 9.0)     / (SUM(pgl.outs_pitched)::FLOAT / 3.0)                AS era FROM pitcher_game_logs AS pgl JOIN players               AS pl   ON unaccent(concat(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name")) = unaccent('Zack Wheeler') WHERE pgl.pitcher_id = pl.key_mlbam::INT   AND EXTRACT(year FROM pgl.game_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
How many saves has Josh Hader recorded through May 2025?

SELECT SUM(CAST(ps.saves AS INTEGER)) AS total_saves FROM pitcher_season_statistics AS ps JOIN players AS pl   ON pl.key_mlbam = ps.key_mlbam WHERE CONCAT(pl."First_Name", ' ', pl."Last_Name") = 'Josh Hader'   AND ps.season = 2025   AND ps.games < (     SELECT MAX(ps2.games) * 3.1     FROM pitcher_season_statistics AS ps2     WHERE ps2.season = 2025   )
Which player in merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 logged the highest hard_hit_percent in May 2025?

SELECT name, ROUND(SUM(strikeOuts)::FLOAT / NULLIF(SUM(atBats), 0), 3) AS so_per_ab FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 GROUP BY name HAVING SUM(atBats + baseOnBalls + hitByPitch + sacFlies) >= (SELECT MAX(games_played) * 3.1 FROM teams) ORDER BY so_per_ab DESC LIMIT 1;
Show the top 5 players by regression_game_score in merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 across all of 2025.
SELECT   m.player_id,   m.name,   m.regression_game_score FROM merged_pitch_box_scores_2025 AS m WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM m.game_date) = 2025 ORDER BY m.regression_game_score DESC LIMIT 5
